korrupsiyaga-qarshi-kurashish-komplayens: Objectives and functions of the Department for the management of the anti-corruption “Compliance Control” system
The Department is a structural unit of the Fergana Medical Institute of Public Health.

The activity of the Department is aimed at managing the “Compliance Control” system and carrying out anti-corruption activities in the higher education institution; within its powers it reports directly to the rector of the Fergana Medical Institute of Public Health and to the Compliance Control and Anti-Corruption Department of the Ministry of Higher and Secondary Specialised Education (hereinafter the Ministry).

In its activity the Department is guided by the Constitution and laws of the Republic of Uzbekistan, resolutions of the Oliy Majlis, decrees, resolutions and orders of the President, resolutions and orders of the Cabinet of Ministers, orders and Board decisions of the Ministry, internal orders of the university and other legislative acts.
Ensuring the implementation of measures aimed at carrying out the “Corruption-free sector” project at the institute;
Introducing and implementing the anti-corruption “Compliance Control” system at the institute;
Identifying the areas of the institute with high corruption risks and the causes and conditions of corruption offences;
Informing about systemic problems leading to manifestations of corruption at the institute, with proposals for eliminating them;
Ensuring the implementation of programmes aimed at eliminating the causes and conditions of corruption offences and increasing the effectiveness of anti-corruption measures at the institute;
Coordinating public control aimed at combating corruption at the institute, and conducting anti-corruption monitoring using modern methods and information and communication technologies;
Studying generally recognised international standards and positive foreign experience in the field of anti-corruption and public control and developing proposals for applying advanced practices;
Organising sociological, scientific and other research on the state, trends and causes of corruption at the institute and the effectiveness of anti-corruption measures, and developing proposals;
Coordinating the anti-corruption activities of the academic lyceum attached to the institute.
To perform its tasks, the Department carries out the following functions:
Monitors compliance with anti-corruption laws and by-laws, as well as resolutions and orders of the Ministry Board, at the institute;

Develops measures and work plans aimed at preventing corruption offences, ensures their full, high-quality and timely implementation, studies the state of implementation of the measures and prepares information on the results;
Develops drafts of internal documents on anti-corruption measures at the institute and submits them to the rector for approval.
Develops proposals for eliminating corruption-related norms identified in the internal documents of the institute.
Assesses corruption risks at the institute and develops action plans for reducing them;

Considers appeals and anonymous reports on corruption risks and offences in the conduct of professors and teachers, managerial, technical, service and educational support staff, and takes measures in the established order;
Keeps a register of official investigations into corruption facts at the institute;
Takes part in analysing conflicts of interest in public procurement and in checking the reliability of counterparties;
Monitors conflicts of interest among the staff of the institute and submits proposals;
Regularly organises preventive talks among professors and teachers, managerial, technical, service and educational support staff;

Conducts surveys among professors and teachers, managerial, technical, service and educational support staff, students (master’s students, doctoral students, clinical residents, independent researchers) and the population in order to identify corruption cases in the institute’s activity;

Regularly assesses the results and impact of anti-corruption promotion measures on the basis of surveys and social and other research, and uses the results of the assessment in determining further measures;
Organises, among professors, teachers and students, measures aimed at combating corruption

ru.text: В Ферганском медицинском институте общественного здоровья в рамках общенационального проекта «Зеленое пространство» организован экочемпион «Новое дерево - новое дыхание»

en.text: In the Ferghana Medical Institute of Public Health, within the framework of the national project "Green Space," an eco-champion "New Tree - New Breath" was organized

uz.text: Fargʻona jamoat salomatligi tibbiyot instituti tomonidan “Yashil makon” umummilliy tashabbusi doirasida “Yangi daraxt — yangi nafas” nomli keng qamrovli ekochempionat boshlab yuborildi. Ushbu tadbir “Yashil universitet” dasturi tamoyillariga toʻliq mos boʻlib, ekologik muhitni yaxshilash, barqaror rivojlanish gʻoyalarini ilgari surish va yoshlarning atrof-muhitga nisbatan masʻuliyatini oshirishga qaratilgan.

ru.text: В рамках общенациональной инициативы «Зеленое пространство» Ферганским медицинским институтом общественного здоровья был запущен комплексный экоклемпион «Новое дерево - новое дыхание». Данное мероприятие полностью соответствует принципам программы «Зеленый университет» и направлено на улучшение экологической среды, продвижение идей устойчивого развития и повышение ответственности молодежи за окружающую среду.

en.text: Within the framework of the nationwide initiative "Green Space," the Ferghana Medical Institute of Public Health launched a comprehensive ecoclampion "New Tree - New Breath." This event fully complies with the principles of the Green University program. It is aimed at improving the environmental environment, promoting sustainable development ideas, and increasing the responsibility of young people for the environment.

uz.text: Ekochempionatning asosiy maqsadi — institut hududi va unga tutash maydonlarda yangi koʻchatlar ekish orqali yashil makonlar sonini oshirish, talaba-yoshlar, professor-oʻqituvchilar hamda xodimlar orasida ekologik madaniyatni shakllantirish va tabiatni asrash masʻuliyatini kuchaytirishdan iborat.

ru.text: Основная цель чемпионата - увеличение количества зеленых насаждений путем посадки новых саженцев на территории института и прилегающих к нему площадях, формирование экологической культуры среди студенческой молодежи, профессорско-преподавательского состава и работников, усиление ответственности за сохранение природы.

en.text: The primary objective of the championship is to expand the number of green spaces by planting new seedlings on the institute's territory and adjacent areas, fostering environmental awareness among students, faculty, and staff, and promoting greater responsibility for nature conservation.

items: Institutning barcha fakultetlari, kafedralari va boʻlimlari oʻrtasida “Eng koʻp daraxt ekkan jamoa” hamda “Eng chiroyli yashil burchak” nominatsiyalari boʻyicha bellashuvlar tashkil etiladi;
Talabalar tomonidan manzarali va mevali daraxt koʻchatlari, gul koʻchatlari ekiladi;
Har bir ekilgan daraxt uchun masʻul talabalar guruhi belgilanadi, bu esa daraxtlarning parvarishi va barqaror yashovchanligini taʻminlaydi;
Ekologik seminarlar, tozalik aksiyalari, yashil hududlarni parvarishlash boʻyicha mahorat darslari oʻtkaziladi.
среди всех факультетов, кафедр и отделов Института будут организованы конкурсы по номинациям «Команда, высаживающая наибольшее количество деревьев» и «Самый красивый зеленый уголок»;
Студентами высаживаются декоративные и плодовые саженцы деревьев, цветов;
Для каждого посаженного дерева определяется ответственная группа студентов, которая обеспечивает уход за деревьями и их устойчивую жизнь;
Будут проведены экологические семинары, акции чистоты, мастер-классы по уходу за зелеными насаждениями.

among all faculties, departments, and departments of the Institute, competitions will be organized in the nominations "The team planting the largest number of trees" and "The most beautiful green corner";
Students plant decorative and fruit seedlings of trees, flowers.
For each tree planted, a responsible group of students is identified to ensure that the trees are cared for and live sustainably.
Environmental seminars, cleanliness campaigns, and master classes on caring for green spaces will be held.

en.text: Staff of the Faculty of Preventive Medicine and Public Health, together with the “Tinchlik” mahalla citizens’ assembly, organised outreach events on the theme “The cleanliness of my neighbourhood is the prosperity of my homeland”, aimed at forming a culture of cleanliness among the population, especially young people, improving their attitude to the environment and raising their social responsibility.

uz.text: Yashil Universitet atamasi, asosan, ekologik barqarorlik va yashil texnologiyalarga qaratilgan taʻlim muassasalariga ishlatiladi, ammo har bir universitet oʻzining maxsus yoʻnalishlari va dasturlari bilan ajralib turadi. Yashil Universitetlar iqlim oʻzgarishi, atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish va barqaror rivojlanishga oid taʻlim berishda etakchi hisoblanadi.

ru.text: Термин «зеленый университет» в основном используется в образовательных учреждениях, ориентированных на экологическую стабильность и зеленые технологии, но каждый университет отличается своими специальными направлениями и программами. Зеленые университеты являются лидерами в области образования в области изменения климата, охраны окружающей среды и устойчивого развития.

en.text: The term "green university" is mainly used in educational institutions focused on environmental stability and green technology, but each university differs in its special areas and programs. Green universities are leaders in climate change education, environmental protection, and sustainable development.

items: Ekologiya va Atrof-Muhit Fanlari: Ekologiya, biologiya, kimyo va fizika kabi fanlardan kelib chiqib, atrof-muhit innovatsiyalari boʻyicha taʻlim beradi. Talabalar ekosistemalar, biodiversitet va tabiiy resurslarni boshqarish masalalariga qaratilgan tadqiqotlar oʻtkazadilar.

Barqaror Rivojlanish: Barqaror rivojlanish nazariyalari va amaliyotlari, ijtimoiy va iqtisodiy masala hamda muhofaza qilish tadbirlari orqali, talabalarni barqaror rivojlanish loyihalariga tayyorlaydi.

Yashil Texnologiyalar: Qayta tiklanuvchi energiya manbalari, energiya samaradorligi, va yashil muhandislik kabi sohalarda muhim koʻnikmalarni rivojlantiradi. Talabalarni energetika va transport tizimlarida barqaror yechimlarni ishlab chiqish uchun tayyorlaydi.
Agrar va Resurs Boshqaruvi: Qishloq xoʻjaligi va tabiiy resurslarni barqaror boshqarish boʻyicha taʻlim, xorijiy va mahalliy tajribalarni oʻrganish orqali amalga oshiriladi.

Ijtimoiy Masalalar va Barqarorlik: Ijtimoiy barqarorlik, ekologik adolat va boshqa ijtimoiy masalalar boʻyicha bilim beradi. Talabalar ijtimoiy muammolarni hal etish uchun innovatsion yechimlar ishlab chiqishadi.

Науки об экологии и окружающей среде: преподаёт экологические инновации на основе таких наук, как экология, биология, химия и физика. Студенты проводят исследования по вопросам экосистем, биоразнообразия и управления природными ресурсами.
Устойчивое развитие: готовит студентов к проектам устойчивого развития через теории и практики устойчивого развития, социальные и экономические вопросы и меры по охране природы.

Зелёные технологии: развивает важные навыки в таких областях, как возобновляемые источники энергии, энергоэффективность и зелёная инженерия. Готовит студентов к разработке устойчивых решений в энергетических и транспортных системах.
Аграрное и ресурсное управление: обучение устойчивому управлению сельским хозяйством и природными ресурсами осуществляется через изучение зарубежного и местного опыта.
Социальные вопросы и устойчивость: даёт знания о социальной стабильности, экологической справедливости и других социальных вопросах. Студенты разрабатывают инновационные решения социальных проблем.

Ecology and environmental sciences: teaches environmental innovation drawing on ecology, biology, chemistry and physics. Students conduct research on ecosystems, biodiversity and the management of natural resources.
Sustainable development: prepares students for sustainable development projects through the theories and practices of sustainable development, social and economic issues and conservation measures.
Green technologies: develops important skills in renewable energy, energy efficiency and green engineering. Prepares students to develop sustainable solutions in energy and transport systems.
Agrarian and resource management: training in the sustainable management of agriculture and natural resources is carried out by studying foreign and local experience.
Social issues and sustainability: provides knowledge of social stability, environmental justice and other social issues. Students develop innovative solutions to social problems.
Iqtisodiy foydalar: Barqaror texnologiyalarni qoʻllash orqali xarajatlarni kamaytirish.
Mahalliy va jadal innovatsiyalar: Yashil texnologiyalarni ishlab chiqish va ularni amalga oshirish.
Ijtimoiy barqarorlik: Ijtimoiy rivojlanishga yordam berish va atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilishda keng jamoatchilikni jalb qilish.
Экономические выгоды: снижение затрат за счёт применения устойчивых технологий.
Местные и ускоренные инновации: разработка и внедрение зелёных технологий.
Социальная устойчивость: содействие социальному развитию и вовлечение широкой общественности в охрану окружающей среды.
Economic benefits: reducing costs through the use of sustainable technologies.
Local and accelerated innovation: developing and implementing green technologies.
Social sustainability: promoting social development and involving the wider public in environmental protection.
